messages:
anita_pm: Quick proposal — run a 1-week aftercare mini-iteration (Mon-Fri) to address top regressions from the launch. Scope: fix top 3 customer-impacting bugs, one small UX enhancement, and a light monitoring/alert tidy-up. Objective: reduce customer-reported incidents by 60% and improve success rate for streaming responses from 92% -> 98%.

jess_prod: Sounds reasonable. Can we lock the enhancement to something with a clear acceptance test? Prefer a small UX tweak (autocomplete debounce) that’s safe to roll back.

mike_eng: I can take the autocomplete debounce change but need to confirm it won't regress cold-start p99. Will prototype with a flag. ETA for PR: Tue EOD.

carol_support: Customer signal — 4 accounts reported degraded autocomplete since launch; two are on Dedicated. If we can get a patch this week they’ll be happy. Also seeing a spike in aborted streaming sessions (logs attached in the support ticket).

lee_sre: For the bug fixes, we need a deploy window and a canary plan. Recommend small canary (5% traffic) for 30 mins, metrics: error-rate, p95 latency, stream-connection drops. If green, promote.

anita_pm: +1 to canary. Proposed prioritization: 1) streaming abort root cause (highest severity), 2) embedding index mismatch for N customers, 3) rate-limiter miscount for edge case. Then UX tweak. Agree?

jess_prod: Agree on priority. Add acceptance criteria: reproduction steps + test prompt set (we'll run the eval harness). Also add a rollback criterion: any p95 spike >20% vs baseline.

mike_eng: Working on #1 now — found a race in KV cache refresh under load. Small patch in review: fixes stale pointers + adds a debug flag. I’ll include a perf microbenchmark.

lee_sre: Deploy-bot: when we roll, please run the following quick checks before promoting to 100%:
```
- check error_rate(streaming) < baseline * 1.2
- p95_latency < baseline + 20ms
- cpu_gpu_utilization < 85% on serving nodes
```

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout window set for 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC -> 11:00 UTC. Canary at 09:15 for 30m. Notifying oncall.

carol_support: I'll notify the affected customers about the planned window and offer a dedicated test during the canary.

anita_pm: Owners and handoffs: mike_eng -> streaming bug; lee_sre -> rollout + monitoring; jess_prod -> acceptance tests + eval prompts; carol_support -> customer comms. Can we confirm bandwidth (who’s OOO)?

mike_eng: I'm in. No PTO this week.

jess_prod: I can get the test set ready by Mon morning.

lee_sre: Oncall is covered. I'll create dashboards and a quick runbook (link will be in the canary thread).

anita_pm: Great — if everyone’s aligned, we’ll ship the mini-iteration. If any blockers emerge, ping here. :thumbsup:

carol_support: Thanks — will share customer times for dedicated tests.

mike_eng: FYI, small note — if debounce reduces requests considerably we should re-evaluate batching thresholds after rollout. Will add a follow-up ticket.

jess_prod: Noted. Add to next sprint backlog if needed.

lee_sre: Closing loop: I’ll post canary results in this thread after 10:00 UTC on 2026-03-25.

anita_pm: Thanks team — moving to execution.
